subject: Is your 3D data pipeline slowing model development?
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've noticed that many of the to ML teams I speak to in the physical AI space find 3D cuboid labeling to be a big bottleneck in their pipeline.

As point cloud datasets grow, drawing cuboids frame by frame turns into a slow, expensive grind and it's hard to scale.

So we're hosting a short, 20-minute masterclass on the 19th of Feb to walk through how teams are moving away from manual-first 3D annotation and into autolabeling workflows, where models generate cuboids and humans focus on review, fixes, and edge cases.

You can save your spot here: [LINK] Or, if you can't make it live, sign up: [LINK] anyway and we'll send you the recording.

subject: Thoughts for [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following [COMPANY]'s work in fraud detection and know that keeping
false-positive rates low while staying ahead of new fraud patterns is a
constant challenge.

We built Encord to help with exactly that. Our ML Ops platform gives IDV
and fraud prevention teams better tools for data curation, which translates
directly into higher model accuracy and faster iteration.

Would you be open to a brief call next week to explore if there's a fit?

subject: Thoughts for LandingAI
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've been following LandingAI's work on agentic document extraction -
impressive how you're tackling complex, real-world docs in production.

Once document AI is live, the bottleneck shifts from extraction accuracy to
reliably surfacing failures - layout drift, OCR ambiguity, multilingual
edge cases.

Closing that loop back into training and eval, without burning engineering
cycles, is where things get hard.

Curious how your team is thinking about this as ADE scales - would you be
open to connecting next week?

subject: Thoughts for [COMPANY]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Impressive work on the 30B-parameter contact centre LLM and VoiceAI Agents.

A common bottleneck we hear from teams training at this scale: data quality
- especially with noisy audio transcripts and precise labelling across
compliance, sentiment, and intent.

Encord helps AI teams curate and annotate training data at scale with
AI-assisted and human-in-the-loop workflows.

Open to connecting next week to see if we could help?
